title: Ball b post-collision speed
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be 6 m/s.

title: Ball a maximum speed
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for part (2) must be 4.9 m/s (or √(2g(L+R))).

title: v0 range endpoints
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (3) must state the range 5 m/s < v0 ≤ 9.8 m/s.

title: Energy conservation for ball b
description: Important Criteria: Applies conservation of mechanical energy from point B to P, relating v_b1 to v_b2 and the height gain (2R+L).

title: Centripetal condition at P
description: Important Criteria: States the condition for circular motion at the top point P: m_b*g ≤ m_b*v_b2²/R, leading to v_b2 ≥ √(gR).

title: Elastic collision equations
description: Important Criteria: Correctly applies both momentum and kinetic energy conservation for the 1D elastic collision between balls a and b.

title: Work-energy on rough track
description: Important Criteria: Applies the work-energy theorem for ball a on AQ, relating v_a1 to friction: v_a1² > 2μgs.

title: Energy limit for ball a
description: Optional Criteria: Recognizes the upper limit for v_a1 from converting all kinetic energy to potential at the top of the arc: v_a1max = √(2g(L+R)).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses an incorrect sign in the 1D momentum equation (e.g., adding velocities for same direction post-collision).

title: Unit or inequality mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Presents final range with incorrect inequality signs (e.g., using ≤ instead of < for the lower bound from friction).
